memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: Then Moses gave to the Gadites, the Reubenites and the half-tribe of Manasseh son of Joseph the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan—the whole land with its cities and the territory around them. The Gadites built up Dibon, Ataroth, Aroer, Atroth Shophan, Jazer, Jogbehah, Beth Nimrah and Beth Haran as fortified cities, and built pens for their flocks. - Num 32:33-36 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
With the agreement settled, Moses grants the land — and the account carefully lists the cities the tribes rebuilt and fortified. Notice the shift from taking to building. They did not merely receive the land; they rolled up their sleeves and made it a home, constructing cities and building pens for their flocks. The gift of God became the setting for their diligent work.

This is a healthy picture of how grace and effort work together. God gave them the land freely — it was His to give, subdued by His power. Yet they still had to build. Receiving God's provision does not make us passive; it invites us into partnership. He supplies the gift; we steward it with faithful labour.

The same is true in our walk with God. He gives us new life, gifts, opportunities, and callings — all by grace. But we are then called to build, to cultivate, to work faithfully with what He has entrusted to us. Paul says we are God's fellow workers (1 Cor 3:9), and that we are to work out our salvation, because God is at work in us (Phil 2:12-13).

So we neither sit back in idleness nor strive in our own strength. We build on what God has given, depending on His power at work within us. Whatever "land" God has entrusted to you — a family, a job, a ministry, a set of gifts — take it up and build faithfully, for His glory.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Are you actively "building" on what God has given you, or letting it lie idle?
2. How do you keep grace and diligent effort in healthy balance?
3. What has God entrusted to you that needs faithful stewardship right now?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, thank You for all You have graciously given me. Make me a faithful builder, working diligently with Your gifts while depending on Your power at work within me. Amen.
